items.title: GPT-6 Astra Is the First Model OpenAI Classifies as Critical for Cybersecurity
items.blurb: OpenAI has classified GPT-6 Astra at the Critical cybersecurity threshold under its Preparedness Framework, a first.

items.title: Repeated VM Escapes By GPT-5.6-Cyber Based Agents Prove VMs and OS' Require Better Maintenance
items.blurb: Traditional virtual machines are inadequate for isolating cyber-capable autonomous agents. Tests using GPT-5.6-Cyber indicated multiple escape attempts due to kernel flaws.

items.title: DeepSeek v4.1 Flash Is Now Our Best Hacking Model
items.blurb: DeepSeek’s 11/11 result showed why advanced agent benchmarks need to check both the outcome and the attack path: our audit confirmed six planned exploits and found five unexpected routes.

items.title: PS5 Linux lead quits: "a bunch of noobs using LLMs" that "they don't understand"
items.blurb: The lead of the ongoing PS5 Linux project has left the homebrew scene following the wave of AI vibe-coders joining open-source spaces.

items.title: Shopify Drops React Native for Swift and Kotlin as AI Changes Cross-Platform Development Tradeoffs
items.blurb: Shopify recently announced it is abandoning React Native to rewrite its flagship apps in Swift and Kotlin.

items.title: OSRS Wiki and RuneLite are increasingly under strain from low-effort AI development
items.blurb: I spend an unusual amount of time making weird graphs about RuneScape, and this is the single craziest graph I've ever seen.

items.title: Why i'm still bearish on LLMs after Navier-Stokes
Microsoft Open-Sources TauGrid to Simplify AI Workload Management on Kubernetes
items.blurb: Microsoft has open-sourced TauGrid, a cloud-native platform designed to manage, schedule, and monitor AI workloads on GPU-enabled Kubernetes clusters. By Sergio De Simone

items.title: Dropbox Evolves Riviera Content Processing Platform to Support AI Workloads
items.blurb: Dropbox has evolved Riviera from a file preview service into a universal content processing platform supporting more than 300 file formats and over 100 transformation capabilities.

items.title: Claude Cowork and chat are now one Claude
items.blurb: Starting today, Claude Cowork and chat are one Claude, rolling out on Pro and Max plans. Hand over the task and Claude does the work. You keep the final say.
